description: Save-worthy vertical slide deck that explains a project through deterministic cards, screenshots, and crisp claims.
recommended_use: High-volume, save-optimized, muted-viewing. Best when the content is dense or stat-heavy and survives without sound. NOTE: rally_002 attempt failed because pure text-card T2V generation can't add motion; this card needs a deterministic FFmpeg/Remotion path before it's production-ready.
reference_notes: Optimize for saves and dwell time rather than cinematic motion.
Every slide should communicate one idea.
Use big claims only when backed by source data.
Use ambient or trending audio if posted as a carousel, but the slides must work muted.
Design should feel native to social slides, not like a pitch deck screenshot.

composition_rules: Keep text large enough for phone reading.
Use source footnotes for proof-bearing claims.
Do not rely on generated small text.
Use consistent margins and slide numbers.

default_routes.hook: deterministic slide card with bold claim
default_routes.context: deterministic slide card plus repo/readme screenshot
default_routes.evidence: real screenshot or deterministic source-backed card
